issues.t: Drive motor software can shut off power while driving (recall)
issues.sym: The iX suddenly loses drive power and coasts, usually with a drivetrain warning on the dash.
issues.why: Software in the electric drive motor controller can wrongly shut down the high-voltage system. BMW recalled about 71,000 electric BMWs for this, including 2022-2024 iX models.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The fix is a free software update, over the air or at a dealer. If power cuts out, steer to a safe spot and call BMW roadside assistance.

issues.t: Battery cell modules may be assembled wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Loss of drive power and a high-voltage warning, though many cars show nothing until a module fails.
issues.why: Some high-voltage battery cell modules may not have been assembled properly, which stresses the module frame. A failing module can shut down the high-voltage system and raise the risk of fire.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 25V-470. The dealer replaces the affected modules free.

issues.t: "Drivetrain Malfunction" message from a failed charging unit
issues.sym: A "Drivetrain Malfunction" message appears, the iX may not go into drive or charge, and some owners need a tow.
issues.why: The combined charging unit (CCU), which runs charging and feeds the 12-volt system, can have a manufacturing defect, an internal coolant leak or a high-voltage insulation fault. BMW issued several bulletins on it.
issues.next: Have the vehicle towed or driven to a BMW dealer. The CCU is a high-voltage part and should be covered by warranty on a vehicle this new.

issues.t: Battery control software can cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power with a drivetrain or high-voltage warning.
issues.why: Software in the high-voltage battery control unit can interrupt power to the drive system.
issues.next: Make sure the free battery software update has been done. A dealer can check your VIN.

issues.t: High-voltage battery can short circuit and catch fire (recall)
issues.sym: Most affected vehicles show no warning. Some may show a high-voltage system warning.
issues.why: A small number of iX xDrive50 and M60 batteries could have internal damage that leads to a short circuit and fire risk.
issues.next: If your iX is under this recall and not yet fixed, BMW advises not to drive or charge it and to park it outside away from buildings. The battery is replaced free.

issues.t: Battery cell monitoring circuit connections loose (recall)
issues.sym: The iX may not start or may shut down while driving.
issues.why: Electrical connections in the high-voltage battery's cell monitoring circuit may not be secured properly, which can cut power.
issues.next: Check for recall 23V-295. The dealer replaces the monitoring circuit free.

issues.t: Charging unit may be assembled wrong and cut power (recall)
issues.sym: The iX can lose power while driving and may show a drivetrain or charging warning.
issues.why: Parts inside the combined charging unit (CCU) on some iX xDrive50 and M60 models may not be connected or assembled correctly.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for recall 23V-449. The CCU is replaced free.

issues.t: Cruise control can switch back on while turning (recall)
issues.sym: The vehicle speeds up unexpectedly at low speed after you turn the steering wheel, because cruise control has resumed.
issues.why: A software logic issue let the steering-wheel controls reactivate cruise control by accident during low-speed turns.
issues.next: Check for recall 23V-409. The dealer updates the software free. Until then, keep cruise control fully off in parking lots.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not inflate correctly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. The problem would show up only in a crash.
issues.why: Some driver front airbags may have been made incorrectly and may not deploy as designed.
issues.next: Check for recall 23V-079. The dealer replaces the driver airbag free.

issues.t: Airbag warning light may not come on when needed (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing obvious. The airbag light may stay off even when there is a fault.
issues.why: Incorrect airbag control software could fail to light the warning lamp if the airbag or pedestrian protection system had a problem.
issues.next: Check for recall 22V-240. The dealer reprograms the airbag module free.

issues.t: Pedestrian warning sound may not play (recall)
issues.sym: People outside can't hear the iX approaching at low speed.
issues.why: The sound generator unit may fault at start-up and not produce the required low-speed warning sound.
issues.next: Check for recall 23V-026. The dealer updates the software free.

issues.t: Warnings hidden in Valet Parking Mode (recall)
issues.sym: In Valet Parking Mode, the display may not show important warnings or warning lights.
issues.why: A head unit software error hid critical warnings in that mode.
issues.next: Check for recall 22V-483. The dealer updates the software free.

issues.t: M60 final drive gear weld may be faulty (recall)
issues.sym: Possible noise from the drive unit, or a sudden loss of drive.
issues.why: A final drive gear in the electric drive unit may have a badly made weld seam. NHTSA lists a very small number of iX M60s.
issues.next: Check for recall 22V-741. The dealer replaces the electric drive unit free.

issues.t: Whine or grinding from the front electric motor
issues.sym: A growing whine, hum or grinding from the front of the vehicle while driving.
issues.why: BMW found that a bearing in the front electric drive unit can fail from a manufacturing defect and put a delivery stop on some 2023 models.
issues.next: Have a dealer check for bulletin B120422. Repairs should be covered by warranty.

issues.t: Reduced steering assist warning at start-up
issues.sym: A warning appears when you start the vehicle and steering feels heavy while parking, or a message says steering behavior has changed and the turning circle is larger.
issues.why: BMW issued bulletins for steering warnings at start-up and for changed steering behavior.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the steering codes and check bulletins B320124 and SIB330123. Heavy steering makes low-speed driving harder, so do not ignore it.

issues.t: Coolant leak under the vehicle and weak cabin heat
issues.sym: Coolant drips under the iX, a coolant warning message, and weak heat from the vents.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for coolant leaks that also reduce heater output.
issues.next: Don't keep topping up coolant without finding the leak. Have a dealer check bulletin B170124; it is usually a warranty repair.

issues.t: Climate control weak or uneven, low airflow
issues.sym: Poor heating or cooling, different temperatures from left and right vents, or weak airflow while the fan is running.
issues.why: BMW issued bulletins for irregular climate control and low vent airflow.
issues.next: Have a dealer check bulletins B640822 and B640823.

issues.t: Windshield fogs up and recirculation flap noise
issues.sym: The inside of the windshield mists up after start-up, and you may hear a noise from the recirculation flap.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for windshield fogging tied to the recirculation flap.
issues.next: Use the defrost setting. Ask a dealer about bulletin SIB640222.

issues.t: Sky Lounge glass roof buzzes at highway speed
issues.sym: A buzzing noise from the glass roof at highway speeds.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for buzzing from the Sky Lounge panoramic roof.
issues.next: Have a dealer check bulletin B540322; it is a warranty noise repair.

issues.t: Groaning or creaking from the dash or front end
issues.sym: Groaning from the dashboard area when the cabin is cold, groaning from the front when cornering, or cracking from rear trim panels.
issues.why: BMW issued several bulletins for interior and front-end groaning and trim noises.
issues.next: Note when the noise happens and ask the dealer about bulletins B511022 and B410124.

issues.t: Tailgate sometimes won't open
issues.sym: The power tailgate does not open from the button or key fob, or it creaks while moving.
issues.why: BMW issued bulletins for the tailgate failing to open now and then and for actuator noise.
issues.next: Try the button again and have a dealer check bulletins B512422 and B514616.

issues.t: Keyless entry or key detection fails
issues.sym: Doors don't unlock as you approach, the iX doesn't recognize the key or phone key, or a "Vehicle key missing" message appears.
issues.why: BMW issued bulletins for comfort access and digital key problems, some after software updates.
issues.next: Use the physical key or press the fob button. Ask the dealer for the latest software.

issues.t: CarPlay drops, Bluetooth glitches or audio cuts out
issues.sym: Apple CarPlay disconnects, Bluetooth won't pair or delete phones, maps show the wrong location, or all sound cuts out.
issues.why: BMW issued several bulletins for CarPlay, Bluetooth, GPS drift and audio dropouts. Most are fixed with software.
issues.next: Restart the system and update the software. If it keeps happening, ask the dealer about bulletins B652723 and B840523.

issues.t: Red airbag light after seat memory is lost
issues.sym: The red airbag light comes on with a message, and the seat memory positions are lost.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin linking lost seat position setup to an airbag warning.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the codes and re-initialize the seats. Don't ignore a red airbag light.

issues.t: Brake pedal creaks when pressed
issues.sym: A creaking noise from the pedal area when you press or release the brake.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for creaking from the brake pedal area.
issues.next: Mention bulletin SIB350123 to the dealer. Have the brakes checked if the pedal feels different.

issues.t: Rear light fault messages
issues.sym: Messages warn of a fault in the rear lights.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for taillamp fault messages.
issues.next: Walk around the vehicle to see if a light is out, then have a dealer check bulletin B630622.

issues.t: Camera-based driver assistance faults
issues.sym: Lane keeping, adaptive cruise or other camera-based features act up or turn off.
issues.why: BMW issued a bulletin for complaints about the camera-based driver assistance system.
issues.next: Keep the windshield clean near the camera. Ask a dealer to check bulletin B660523.
